jurisdictionNote: Central Administrative Tribunal constituted under Section 4 of the Administrative Tribunals Act, 1985. Exclusive jurisdiction over service matters of persons appointed to civil services and posts in connection with the affairs of the Union. Principal Bench at New Delhi; benches across India. Appeals lie to the jurisdictional High Court (Chandra Kumar, 1997).

localRules: Pleadings governed by the Central Administrative Tribunal (Procedure) Rules, 1987 and the Administrative Tribunals Act, 1985.
Form of Original Application as per Form-I prescribed under the CAT Rules; statutory annexures and impugned order copy mandatory.
Limitation: O.A. must be filed within one year from the date the cause of action arose, or within 6 months of the final order on the statutory representation, whichever is later (Section 21).
Mandatory pre-condition: representation must have been made and exhausted under the applicable service rules before approaching CAT (Section 20).
Court fee as per CAT Rules (currently nominal — Rs. 50/- per O.A., subject to revision).
Application must be verified on solemn affirmation; vakalatnama executed in favour of authorised counsel.
Appeals from CAT orders lie to the jurisdictional High Court under writ jurisdiction (Art. 226), not directly to the Supreme Court.
